terminals.name: dw
terminals.description: Autumn dev stack via bun dw (setup if needed, then run): API :8080, vite :3000, checkout :3001. Infisical machine identity injects Stripe/etc; isolation overlay keeps DB/Redis/SQS on localhost. stripe listen forwards Connect webhooks to the API.

terminals.name: ngrok
terminals.description: Public ngrok tunnels for :3000 (dashboard) and :8080 (API) when NGROK_AUTHTOKEN is in Infisical. Stripe webhooks use stripe listen, not ngrok.

terminals.name: access
terminals.description: How to open the dashboard from a laptop: Cursor port forwarding, remote desktop, or ngrok URLs.
